bound_context.question: What does the 34-byte leaf routine at 0x628f710 do to a BIT_DStream_t, what does it return, and what does it require of its caller?

consumer_table.meaning: rax is overwritten by an unrelated value before the status is read
never read inside the enclosing FDE

caller_census.contract: returns the constant 0 (BIT_DStream_unfinished) and mutates the BIT_DStream_t through its first argument; the return value is discarded by every call site, which is consistent with a constant that carries no information
caller_census.method: every call target matching the window start is decoded with Capstone and attributed to the enclosing .eh_frame FDE; the instruction after the call is classified by how rax is first used

claim_anchors: semantics.tsv (12 anchors: claim -> target instruction address, bytes and decoded instruction)
environment_limits: the packet is static: the artifact is never executed and no source build is claimed
the emulator implements only the instructions this routine uses and raises on any other
the modelled stream pointer is a single fixed base per case; the packet does not model any caller's buffer

layouts.name: BIT_DStream_t (fields touched by this window)

fields.+0x08: bitsConsumed, u32 (read and written back as its sub-byte remainder)
fields.+0x10: ptr, const BYTE* (read and rewritten to the rewound position)

layouts.note: +0x18 (limitPtr) is NOT touched by this body, which is why the body performs no bounds check

ledger: cases.tsv (300 reviewable cases, 75 per family: sub-byte counts, whole-byte counts, mixed values and extreme values up to 0xffffffff) recording the bits consumed, the bytes rewound, the new bit position, the rewound pointer, the loaded container and the status; the boundary rows are kept verbatim and the full 2,400-case sweep is re-derived in memory by the tests

observations.text: the window 0x628f710..0x628f732 is one .eh_frame FDE, 34 bytes, 12 instructions, one leaf routine with no calls and no relocations
there is no endbr64: the body opens with the bitsConsumed load, so it is not an indirect-branch target
bitsConsumed is split by and $0x7 / shr $0x3, and only the sub-byte remainder is written back, so after the call bitsConsumed is always in [0,7]
mov %edx,%ecx zero-extends, so the rewind (bitsConsumed >> 3, up to 0x1fffffff) is unsigned and the pointer moves backward, never forward
the reload is exactly one unconditional 8-byte little-endian load from the rewound pointer, stored over the whole container with no shift or merge
the return value is a constant 0: the only exit is xor %eax,%eax, and the body contains no comparison and no conditional branch
the body performs no bounds check against +0x18 (limitPtr) or any start pointer before the rewind and the 8-byte read
all 16 direct call sites discard the returned value (10 overwrite rax immediately, 6 never read it): no caller branches on the status
the C type is BIT_DStream_t* (a three-field struct at +0x00/+0x08/+0x10) and the parameter is the single register argument rdi, read off the struct offsets and the mangling-free symbol
the constant 0 is zstd's BIT_DStream_unfinished; the other BIT_DStream_status values cannot be produced by this body, and the callers' indifference to the value is consistent with that
the routine is the unchecked fast path (the name says internal): the caller is expected to have established that the rewound pointer still has 8 readable bytes

unknowns: the caller-side obligation is inferred, not proven: the packet shows the body has no bounds check, but does not verify any caller's precondition
whether some sibling body in this object performs the checks this one omits is not established here (candidate siblings are separate windows)
the exact zstd release is not pinned: the body is raw-equal across the candidate versions and no version string is read from it
the body is byte-identical in 3 identical source objects; only 0x628f710 is bound
which of the 16 call sites are reachable at run time for a decompression of a given frame is not characterized
